propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) unless signed by the prod op-cert environment, which is the only pinned environment, making the gate unsatisfiable for locally-reviewed changes

The not-pinned arm of classify_plan_review_attestation returns 'mismatch' verdict when a DSSE principal is absent from trusted_environments.yaml, causing affirmative rejection on source of certification rather than fact of review
No executable path exists for a developer to obtain a prod op-cert attestation because the opcert service has no client in the repo and cannot persist signatures returned from the API

The gate rejects a genuinely signed, same-material plan-review attestation solely on provenance when the signing environment is unpinned, preventing developers from clearing the gate without adding themselves to a CODEOWNERS-gated pinning file

Subject binding (ticket id and kind) is implicit in verify_opcert but would be silently dropped if that function is removed, risking cross-ticket attestation replay if not re-asserted as an explicit step
